mapper.update: UPDATE host_vuln_result SET status = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, host_id, rule_id, severity, vuln_name, product_name, product_version, suggestion, status, verify_status, evidence_json, created_at, updated_at FROM host_vuln_result WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY CASE LOWER(severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id DESC
